1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a location that is __fixed and predetermined during manufacturing__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP is not removable or adjustable after initial embedding__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __with the MTP positioned at a depth of at least 0.5 mm below the outer surface__, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __specifically designed for long-term cryogenic storage of biological samples__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __through a thermal bonding process that creates a permanent mechanical interlock between the MTP and the polymer material__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __such that the MTP is positioned within 5 mm of the geometric center of the bottom surface__.
